statusText: Tail 11% (low), Stress 36% (moderate), Confidence 81% (high). Mapped policy state: EA_ON.

headline: Nasdaq-100 drifts higher on crude relief and constructive U.S.-China talks; no pathological path observed
body: NQ front-month trades 30,114.75, up 0.66% and within 16 points of its 30,130.50 overnight high after a directionally efficient advance from 29,904.50. The 226-point (0.75%) range is modest, so the advance qualifies as a mild one-way drift rather than a mean-reversion failure. Cash ^NDX closed Friday at 29,644.17, up 0.67%, at the top of its 29,371.89-29,647.80 range and about 3.6% below the 52-week high of 30,762.20. The supporting impulse is benign: Brent near $102 and WTI near $98 are in a fourth consecutive decline on Middle East diplomacy signals, with Hormuz oil and LNG flows reported at six-month highs and a possible Trump-Pezeshkian contact at this week's UN General Assembly. The US 10-year eased about 3bp to 4.97% after touching 5.04% last week, and VIX closed at 14.81. Against that, the macro backdrop is genuinely tight: the Fed delivered a unanimous hawkish hike to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16 with a dot plot pointing to more, the 30-year sits near 5.34% and 2s10s is compressed near 25bp. Cross-asset alignment therefore runs in the relief direction rather than as a squeeze, which supports moderate Stress with Tail in the low band. Delayed latest-session context shows semiconductors leading (MU +3.9%, ARM +4.0%, AVGO +3.0%) against weaker software and megacaps split four up, four down; that context is not evidence of live price path. The main conditional risk is the 13:30 UTC cash open, where an aligned bullish overnight regime is the pattern that has previously preceded opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment. Tail stayed in a 5-9 band and Stress in a 28-35 band throughout, with dominant mode normal in every slot. Tail drifted up from 5 to 9 between 22:00 and 01:00 UTC as the futures reopen established a direction, then eased back to 5 by 05:00 UTC while Confidence improved steadily from 70 to 81 as overnight evidence accumulated. No slot approached the block threshold.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps Tail inside the low band across all 24 hours, peaking at 16 around the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and the hour after it, where an aligned bullish overnight regime carries the session's highest opening-continuation risk, then decaying to 8-9 through the post-close and Asian hours. Stress peaks near 41 at the open and eases to 33 overnight. Confidence declines with horizon from 81 to 68. Scheduled checkpoints beyond today are the Sep 23 flash PMIs at 13:45 UTC, weekly claims and new home sales on Sep 24, and durable goods on Sep 25; the Trump-Xi summit in Washington on Sep 24 and possible UN General Assembly contact between Washington and Tehran are the main unscheduled headline levers, with the Nov 10 trade-truce expiry still unresolved.
